candidates.evidence: E2g(1) at 383.8 cm-1 and A1g at 403.3 cm-1, both with Lorentzian FWHM of 2.0 and 3.8 cm-1. Weak features near 231 and 452 cm-1 match LA(M) and 2LA(M). Laser is 532 nm.
The A1g of MoSe2 is near 240 cm-1, and there is no such line.
The WS2 E2g/2LA(M) complex is near 350 cm-1 and A1g near 418 cm-1. These do not match.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was supplied, so this is an identification task.

properties.name: layers
properties.source: A1g - E2g = 19.5 cm-1 (measured). Lee et al., ACS Nano 2010 gives about 18-19 cm-1 for 1L and about 21-22 cm-1 for 2L, so 19.5 is closer to the 1L range.

properties.name: phase
properties.source: E2g/A1g pair. No J1/J2/J3 modes of the 1T phase are seen between 150 and 350 cm-1.

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: The E2g line is narrow (2.0 cm-1) and there are no defect-activated bands.

properties.name: strain_sign
properties.source: The E2g position (383.8) is near the unstrained value of about 384-385 cm-1, but its small downshift is ambiguous. It could be weak tensile strain or the bilayer trend.

Li et al., Adv. Funct. Mater. 22, 1385 (2012): From bulk to monolayer MoS2
limits: The layer count rests on the single peak separation of 19.5 cm-1. It sits between the typical 1L (about 18-19) and 2L (about 21-22) values, so the 1L assignment is tentative.
Strain, doping and substrate effects can shift E2g and A1g by 1-2 cm-1. The shift alone therefore cannot separate 1L from 2L.
The intensity ratio of the two modes was not used. The photoluminescence background was not examined, and the spectrum starts at 150 cm-1.
The low-frequency interlayer shear and breathing modes (below 50 cm-1) are outside the measured range. They would settle the layer count.
The LA(M) and 2LA(M) features are weak and were not fitted. They are assigned from positions only.
No polarization data were given, so no polarization pattern is assigned.
No cosmic-ray spikes were identified. The sharp lines are the MoS2 and Si modes.
